[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for managing GERD symptoms, focusing on dietary changes and lifestyle modifications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested avoiding trigger foods like citrus fruits, tomatoes, chocolate, caffeine, spicy or fatty foods, and mint.
